Describe what changed.

## Testing / الاختبارات
- [ ] `cargo test` and Windows Release build pass
- [ ] No changes to project save format without migration and backward-compatibility tests
- [ ] Update `RELEASE_NOTES.md` with the real new features and fixes in simple US English and Egyptian Arabic
- [ ] Check memory/CPU impact on low-end hardware
- [ ] Test the update button and full version numbering when update logic is changed

## Public tester builds / نسخ التجربة
Every merged change to `main` is automatically published after Windows CI succeeds.
Only merge changes ready for public testing. Contributors can report bugs or request features through GitHub Issues.
